intent: Admit the exact Fleet-owned surfaces required to close the dgc chat canonical-routing bypass and replace status-only runtime activity claims with lease-aware, identity-bound observations without mutating Mission Control owner state or live runtime data.

commit.message: governance: admit fleet trust hardening surfaces

interface_mismatches: dgc chat requires a native interactive Claude Code process, while create_runtime_provider constructs a headless prompt transport; the repair must consume canonical policy and runtime configuration without substituting the headless adapter.

Legacy runtime rows preserve observed status but do not prove a current lease or executor liveness; projections must retain those rows while separating observed_nonterminal, current_lease, and executor_liveness semantics.

The canonical Mission Control projection already handles expired leases and missing terminal receipts honestly; this work must not rewrite Mission Control owner state to repair generic operator read models.
honest_blockers: Disabling the ambient GitHub MCP prevents new sessions from loading that mutation surface but does not revoke provider-side credentials; provider-console rotation remains a separate operator-authorized external action.
A fresh unexpired claim heartbeat is lease evidence, not proof that an executor process is alive, responsive, semantically correct, or making progress.
This admission changes only repository ownership declarations and generated governance projections; it starts no service and mutates no live runtime database.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the governance admission commit. The external MCP quarantine is independently reversible by removing enabled=false from the backed-up user config; this packet itself changes no credentials, processes, or runtime state.
